slices.focus: A coworker loans Nadia a Hala Alyan novel, nudging her back to bedtime fiction reading after months of policy-only reading.
slices.summary: A younger coworker loans Nadia the latest Hala Alyan novel at lunch, pulling her back into fiction reading after months of consuming only policy memoirs and immigration reporting. The habit fits into bedtime in short bursts (3-4 pages minimum). Nadia notices she sleeps differently after fiction — less mental looping. She plans to text the coworker a light thank-you, keep the book on the bedside table, keep nonfiction on the desk, and accept one recommendation at a time to avoid turning it into a backlog.
open_loops: Text coworker a light thank-you for the book loan
Keep fiction on bedside table, nonfiction on desk
Ask for one recommendation at a time to avoid creating a backlog
